evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: There is a horizontal tear along the posterior horn extending to the root attachment.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: There is tearing of the inner margin along the body and posterior horn.
evidence.Medial OA: Tricompartmental chondrosis, most prominent at the trochlea.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: There is full-thickness cartilage fissuring at the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Severe cartilage loss is present at the trochlea diffusely with subchondral cystic changes.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
